chunks: The Commander of the Faithful عليه السلام said:
"I like for the believer to use depilatory paste every fifteen days."

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: The title of Imam Ali عليه السلام, meaning the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.أُحِبُّ: I like; an expression of preference and recommendation
key_terms.خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً: Fifteen days; the recommended interval mentioned in the report
key_terms.لِلْمُؤْمِنِ: For the believer; referring to the faithful person
key_terms.يَطَّلِيَ: To apply depilatory paste for removing hair

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام recommend about using depilatory paste for personal cleanliness?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام expresses a preference for the believer to maintain personal cleanliness and grooming on a regular schedule. The hadith reflects the Islamic emphasis on taharah, bodily care, and refined etiquette.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.258 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"I like for a believer to use Nuura (depilatory paste) every fifteen days."
